description: The text of one provision (§ or Article) as Markdown. `law` is the abbreviation ('BGB', 'StGB', 'DSGVO'; Hessen: 'HBO'), `ref` the number ('573', '3a'). For the text on a past date add `as_of` (YYYY-MM-DD; versions are held from 2019-06-10). The answer says how many versions are held (`versions_held`) and how many decisions cite the provision (`cited_by`). A version date is the day the text was first seen here, not its Inkrafttreten. Example: {"law": "BGB", "ref": "573"}

as_of.description: Return the version stored for this date.

format.description: 'markdown' (default, compact, quotable) or 'json' for the structured payload.

law.description: Law abbreviation, or a `law_key` (`slug` in search results) when an abbreviation is ambiguous.

ref.description: Provision number without § or Art. A sub-unit ('Abs. 1', 'lit. f') is dropped: the whole provision is returned.

name: getNorm
title: Get statute text
